title: Network analysis
description: Packet captures in a read-only folder, the agent reaches only its provider; TShark and mcpcap as MCP servers.
prompt: Analyse the captures in /mnt/captures: hosts and conversations, protocols, DNS names, anything unusual (beaconing, cleartext credentials, odd ports). Write /work/network-report.md with evidence (frame numbers).
notes: Active scans (hub:nmap) only against targets you may scan: add it yourself, with the policy's allow_within.
